data.name: Hubert Catching
data.detailed_description:
Hubert catching is a fun and simple game where you desperately scramble to throw small living stone pingies (penguins) into a hole, in an attempt to appease the beings that sent you into this realm so they may eventually set you free. Little do you know, your purpose is greater than a simple game.

The task is simple: grab up to 2 Huberts (living stone figures which are also somehow a penguin species) at a time, and then throw them into a hole. Once you have collected 10 Huberts, your time will be recorded and you will be sent back to the main menu. From there you can purchase upgrades and one-time consumables to assist you in achieving a faster time. However the more you play the more you realize that your purpose here was for much more than just simple entertainment.

Content included in the game:

  • A simple catching game where you must grab one moving Hubert at a time in each hand, using left and right click to grab them.

  • A credit system based on your time in each round, where you gain more money based on how fast you win.

  • Consumables which can be bought in the shop and used once in a round before being removed from your inventory.

  • Upgrades which can replace/modify your hands (don’t think too hard about it) to change the method in which you collect Huberts.

  •  A Speedrun Timer and in-game Leaderboard.

(despite how the description may sound, the game does not actually cover most of the story elements. Unless.. Maybe if you get a good enough score… maybe then something will happen? COMING SOON)

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Card
